description: This file defines a client for interacting with the Kubernetes apps v1beta1 API group, including methods for accessing controller revisions, deployments, and stateful sets, along with functions for creating and configuring the client.

classes.name: AppsV1beta1Client
classes.description: Client for interacting with the Kubernetes apps v1beta1 API group, providing methods for accessing controller revisions, deployments, and stateful sets.

methods.name: ControllerRevisions
methods.description: Returns an interface to manage controller revisions within a namespace.

methods.name: Deployments
methods.description: Returns an interface to manage deployments within a namespace.

methods.name: StatefulSets
methods.description: Returns an interface to manage stateful sets within a namespace.

methods.name: NewForConfig
methods.description: Creates a new client using the provided REST configuration.

methods.name: NewForConfigAndClient
methods.description: Creates a new client with a specific REST configuration and HTTP client.

methods.name: NewForConfigOrDie
methods.description: Creates a new client with the provided configuration or panics if an error occurs.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new client from an existing REST interface.
